sentences.text:
Heard Sri Vinay Bhushan Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant as per the instructions submits that though the present application under Section 528 BNSS has been preferred by the applicant for quashing the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1467A/2008 (State Vs Lal Chandra Jain)
under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration (PFA) Act, 1954, Police Station- Mahoba District- Mahoba, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba and summoning order dated 03.06.2008 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, as well as Non Bailable Warrant Order dated 02.02.2021 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba and its consequential proceedings, however, he confines his relief to the extent that since non-bailable warrant has been issued post obtaining of bail on account of the fact that due to certain reasons beyond the control and comprehension the applicant could not participate and join the proceedings, thus a breathing time be accorded to the applicant to submit a recall application to recall the non-bailable warrant before the court below and till the disposal of the recall application, applicant be accorded protection.
2.
Sri Pankaj Srivastava, learned A.G.A. has no objection to the same.

3. Considering the over all facts situation as well as the stand taken by the applicant, the application stands disposed of directing the applicant to submit recall application seeking recall of non-bailable warrant before the court below by 23.09.2025.

4. Till the disposal of the recall application, no coercive action be taken against the applicant with respect to proceedings of Criminal Case No. 1467A/2008 (State Vs Lal Chandra Jain) under Section 7/16 Prevention of Food Adulteration (PFA) Act, 1954, Police Station- Mahoba District- Mahoba,
pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba and summoning order dated 03.06.2008 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, as well as Non Bailable Warrant Order dated 02.02.2021 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mahoba.
